layouts.name: Solo (TP only)
layouts.satz: All cards work as one tensor-parallel group that prefills and decodes; no switching, no front.
why: 4 cards: no release boot has proven this card count on metal yet (the named blocker METAL-UNPROVEN). The numbers come from the launcher dry run; the launcher takes this layout only with force, and the first boot is the proof.

The release profile for this model on 4 cards of this kind is marked blocked (D-BUDGET): the launcher's decode-ownership solver (D-EIGENTUM, #239 S3f) finds no sustainable distribution, and even with force it only passes the D-BUDGET refusal by name. Not startable yet; the cause is open.
